english.title: Driver of taxi / private hire vehicle fail to comply with duties in regard to carriage etc of disabled passenger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a taxi or private hire vehicle namely, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) which

(A)_[had been hired by or for a disabled person,]_
(B)_[had been hired by a person who wished to be accompanied by a disabled person,]
(C)_[was being used to provide a local service and a disabled person had indicated to you that they wished to travel on the service,]_
(D)_[was being used to provide a local service and a person who wished to be accompanied by a disabled person had indicated to you that they wished to travel on the service,]_

failed to comply with the duty to

(E)_[carry the disabled person]_
(F)_[carry the wheelchair of that disabled person who was in it or had it with them]_
(G)_[carry the mobility aids accompanying the disabled person]_
(H)_[take such steps as were reasonable to ensure that the disabled person was carried in safety and reasonable comfort]_
(I)_[give the disabled person such mobility assistance as was reasonably required]_
(J)_[not make, or propose to make, an additional charge for complying with a duty mentioned in section 164A(5) of the Equality Act 2010, namely **(..SPECIFY DUTY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164A(9) and (10) of the Equality Act 2010.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
